WITH daily AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS total_trades,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE pnl_usd > 0) AS winning_trades,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE pnl_usd <= 0) AS losing_trades,
    ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(pnl_usd),0)::numeric, 4) AS total_pnl_usd,
    ROUND(COALESCE(AVG(pnl_pct),0)::numeric, 4) AS avg_pnl_pct,
    ROUND(COALESCE(MAX(pnl_usd),0)::numeric, 4) AS best_trade_usd,
    ROUND(COALESCE(MIN(pnl_usd),0)::numeric, 4) AS worst_trade_usd,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE reason = 'TP atteint') AS tp_count,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE reason = 'SL touche') AS sl_count,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE reason LIKE 'Zombie%') AS zombie_count
  FROM trades_a
  WHERE exit_time >= CURRENT_DATE
    AND exit_time < CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '1 day'
),
alltime AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS total_trades_all,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE pnl_usd > 0) AS winning_all,
    ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(pnl_usd),0)::numeric, 4) AS total_pnl_all
  FROM trades_a
),
cap AS (
  SELECT capital FROM capital_a WHERE id = 1
)
SELECT d.*, a.total_trades_all, a.winning_all, a.total_pnl_all, c.capital
FROM daily d, alltime a, cap c

WITH daily AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS total_trades,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE pnl_usd > 0) AS winning_trades,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE pnl_usd <= 0) AS losing_trades,
    ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(pnl_usd),0)::numeric, 4) AS total_pnl_usd,
    ROUND(COALESCE(AVG(pnl_pct),0)::numeric, 4) AS avg_pnl_pct,
    ROUND(COALESCE(MAX(pnl_usd),0)::numeric, 4) AS best_trade_usd,
    ROUND(COALESCE(MIN(pnl_usd),0)::numeric, 4) AS worst_trade_usd,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE reason = 'TP atteint') AS tp_count,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE reason = 'SL touche') AS sl_count,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE reason LIKE 'Zombie%') AS zombie_count
  FROM trades_c
  WHERE exit_time >= CURRENT_DATE
    AND exit_time < CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '1 day'
),
alltime AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS total_trades_cll,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE pnl_usd > 0) AS winning_all,
    ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(pnl_usd),0)::numeric, 4) AS total_pnl_all
  FROM trades_c
),
cap AS (
  SELECT capital FROM capital_c WHERE id = 1
)
SELECT d.*, a.total_trades_cll, a.winning_all, a.total_pnl_all, c.capital
FROM daily d, alltime a, cap c

WITH trades_propres AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) FILTER (
      WHERE mfe_pct IS NOT NULL 
        AND mae_pct IS NOT NULL 
        AND (mfe_pct != 0 OR mae_pct != 0)
    ) AS n_propres
  FROM trades_d
),
global_stats AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS total_trades,
    ROUND(AVG(mfe_pct), 4) AS avg_mfe,
    ROUND(AVG(mae_pct), 4) AS avg_mae,
    ROUND(AVG(pnl_pct), 4) AS avg_pnl_pct
  FROM trades_d
  WHERE mfe_pct IS NOT NULL
),
long_short AS (
  SELECT
    direction,
    COUNT(*) AS total_trades,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE pnl_pct > 0) AS gagnants,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE pnl_pct < 0) AS perdants,
    ROUND(AVG(pnl_pct), 4) AS avg_pnl_pct
  FROM trades_d
  WHERE mfe_pct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY direction
),
per_hour AS (
  SELECT
    EXTRACT(HOUR FROM entry_time) AS heure,
    COUNT(*) AS total_trades,
    ROUND(AVG(pnl_pct), 4) AS avg_pnl_pct
  FROM trades_d
  WHERE mfe_pct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY heure
)
SELECT
  'progression' AS section,
  tp.n_propres AS trades_propres,
  30 - tp.n_propres AS trades_restants,
  ROUND(tp.n_propres * 100.0 / 30, 2) AS progression_pct,
  NULL::text AS extra

WITH daily AS (

    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE pnl > 0) AS winning_trades,

    ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(pnl),0)::numeric, 4) AS total_pnl_usd,
    ROUND(COALESCE(AVG(pnl/entry_price*100),0)::numeric, 4) AS avg_pnl_pct,

    ROUND(COALESCE(MIN(pnl),0)::numeric, 4) AS worst_trade_usd,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE direction='BUY') AS buy_trades,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE direction='SELL') AS sell_trades,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE pnl > 0 AND direction='BUY') AS buy_wins,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE pnl > 0 AND direction='SELL') AS sell_wins
  FROM trades_gold
  WHERE exit_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'

),
